name: gladys-text2speak
description: Gladys Assistant external integration for the Text2Speak multi-room TTS API

scripts.check:manifest: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('gladys-assistant-integration.json','utf8')); if(m.manifest_version!==1 || m.type!=='provider' || !m.scene_actions?.some(a=>a.key==='tts_speak')) process.exit(1); console.log('Manifest OK');"
